subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Failing to give proper care and attention
solution:
The correct answer is '**lax**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**lax**" means not sufficiently strict, severe, or careful. (ढीला, लापरवाह)
 
• Failing to give proper care and attention is best described by the word "lax".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *He was lax__ in performing his duties, which led to several mistakes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cautious (सावधान)**: means being careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
 
• **Wild (जंगली)**: means living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated.
 
• **Provident (दूरदर्शी)**: means making or indicative of timely preparation for the future.
